opinions: SPANKING CHILDREN IS AN OUTDATED AND HARMFUL PRACTICE THAT FAILS TO TEACH POSITIVE BEHAVIOR.

CHILDREN SHOULD LEARN CRITICAL THINKING AND EMPATHY, NOT JUST DISCIPLINE.
